247	  if [[ ${cell_count} -gt 0 ]]; then

249	      cell_id="${cell_spec%:*}"

251	        | xargs -r docker stop --time=30 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

265	  # Clear in-flight entries (they should have trap handlers that do this too, but be explicit)
266	  : >"${json_path}.tmp"

391	# resolve_tasks emits one task id per line for a bench-set.
392	# Handles three shapes:
393	#   tasks: [id, id, ...]         inline list
394	#   tasks: all                   defer to harness dataset; emit "*all*"
395	#   tasks_from: <path>           load tasks[].id from a sibling YAML
396	# tasks_from and inline tasks merge in deterministic order with duplicates
397	# removed on first occurrence.
398	resolve_tasks() {
399	  local bs_file="$1"
400	  local bs_json tasks_kind tasks_from
401	  bs_json="$(bench_set_json "${bs_file}")"
402	
403	  tasks_kind="$(jq -r '
404	    if (.tasks // null) == null then "none"
405	    elif (.tasks | type) == "array" then "list"
406	    elif (.tasks | type) == "string" then ("string:" + .tasks)
407	    else "other"
408	    end' <<<"${bs_json}")"
409	
410	  tasks_from="$(jq -r '.tasks_from // ""' <<<"${bs_json}")"
411	
412	  if [[ "${tasks_kind}" == "string:all" ]]; then
413	    [[ -z "${tasks_from}" ]] || die "bench-set ${bs_file}: tasks: all cannot be combined with tasks_from"
414	    # Defer to the harness dataset. The plan path emits a sentinel so
415	    # operators see the contract; the run path (PR A4) expands at execution.
416	    printf '*all*\n'
417	    return 0
418	  fi
419	
420	  local -A seen_tasks=()
421	  local emitted=0
422	  local task resolved
423	
424	  emit_task() {
425	    local task="$1"
426	    [[ -n "${task}" ]] || return 0
427	    if [[ -z "${seen_tasks["${task}"]+x}" ]]; then
428	      seen_tasks["${task}"]=1
429	      printf '%s\n' "${task}"
430	      emitted=1
431	    fi
432	  }
433	
434	  if [[ -n "${tasks_from}" ]]; then
435	    resolved="$(cd "$(dirname "${bs_file}")" && cd "$(dirname "${tasks_from}")" && pwd)/$(basename "${tasks_from}")"
436	    [[ -f "${resolved}" ]] || die "tasks_from path not found: ${tasks_from} (resolved to ${resolved})"
437	    while IFS= read -r task; do
438	      emit_task "${task}"
439	    done < <(
440	      yq -o=json '.' "${resolved}" \
441	        | jq -r '
442	            .tasks[]?
443	            | (if type == "object" then (.id // empty) else . end)
444	          '
445	    )
446	  fi
447	
448	  if [[ "${tasks_kind}" == "list" ]]; then
449	    while IFS= read -r task; do
450	      emit_task "${task}"
451	    done < <(jq -r '
452	      .tasks[] | (if type == "object" then (.id // empty) else . end)
453	    ' <<<"${bs_json}")
454	  elif [[ "${tasks_kind}" != "none" ]]; then
455	    die "bench-set ${bs_file}: unsupported tasks shape"
456	  fi
457	
458	  if [[ ${emitted} -eq 0 ]]; then
459	    if [[ -n "${tasks_from}" || "${tasks_kind}" == "list" ]]; then
460	      die "bench-set ${bs_file}: resolved no tasks"
461	    fi
462	    die "bench-set ${bs_file}: no .tasks list, .tasks: all, or .tasks_from set"
463	  fi
464	}

733	  local rep i n

737	    resolve_profile_file "${profile_id}" >/dev/null  # existence check

747	      fi
748	      task_executor="$(resolve_bench_set_task_executor "${bs_file}")"
749	      tasks="$(resolve_tasks "${bs_file}")"
750	      i=0

759	        done

999	# Invoke the task-executor with bounded exponential backoff on transient
1000	# errors. Returns 0 on success; non-zero on terminal failure after retries.
1001	# Captures attempts log to ${cell_dir}/retry-log.txt for forensics.
1002	run_executor_with_retry() {
1003	  local task_spec="$1" cell_dir="$2" executor="$3"
1004	  local stderr_file
1005	  stderr_file="$(mktemp)"
1006	  local max_attempts="${BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS}"
1007	  local backoff="${BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE}"
1008	  local attempt=1
1009	  local status=0
1010	  local retry_log="${cell_dir}/retry-log.txt"
1011	  : >"${retry_log}"
1012	  while :; do
1013	    : >"${stderr_file}"
1014	    set +e
1015	    printf '%s' "${task_spec}" | "${executor}" 2>"${stderr_file}" >/dev/null
1016	    status=$?
1017	    set -e
1018	    printf 'attempt=%d status=%d\n' "${attempt}" "${status}" >>"${retry_log}"
1019	    if [[ ${status} -eq 0 ]]; then
1020	      rm -f "${stderr_file}"
1021	      return 0
1022	    fi
1023	    cat "${stderr_file}" >>"${retry_log}"
1024	    if (( attempt > max_attempts )) || ! is_transient_stderr "${stderr_file}"; then
1025	      cat "${stderr_file}" >&2
1026	      rm -f "${stderr_file}"
1027	      return "${status}"
1028	    fi
1029	    warn "cell $(basename "${cell_dir}"): transient error (attempt ${attempt}); sleeping ${backoff}s"
1030	    sleep "${backoff}"
1031	    backoff=$((backoff * 2))
1032	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
1033	  done
1034	}

1092	# compute_cell_cost prints the cost_usd_at_run_time for a single cell. Uses
1093	# profile.pricing × token streams pulled from the cell's result.json. Token
1094	# field names follow the canonical report-level naming
1095	# (input_tokens / output_tokens / cached_input_tokens) and are also probed
1096	# under the harbor totals naming (total_prompt_tokens / total_completion_tokens
1097	# / total_cached_input_tokens) so harness-native token reporters land in the
1098	# same accumulator.
1099	#
1100	# When profile.pricing is all zero (or unset) and the executor wrote an
1101	# explicit cost_usd / total_cost_usd in result.json, the explicit value is
1102	# honored — that lets harnesses that observe API-reported cost directly
1103	# participate in budget enforcement.
1104	compute_cell_cost() {
1105	  local result_json="${1:-}" profile_json="${2:-}"
1106	  [[ -n "${result_json}" ]] || result_json='{}'
1107	  [[ -n "${profile_json}" ]] || profile_json='{}'
1108	  jq -nr \
1109	    --argjson result "${result_json}" \
1110	    --argjson profile "${profile_json}" \
1111	    '
1112	      def num(v): if (v == null) then 0 else (v | tonumber? // 0) end;
1113	      ($profile.pricing // {}) as $p
1114	      | num($p.input_usd_per_mtok)         as $pi
1115	      | num($p.output_usd_per_mtok)        as $po
1116	      | num($p.cached_input_usd_per_mtok)  as $pc
1117	      | num($result.input_tokens
1118	            // $result.total_prompt_tokens
1119	            // $result.n_input_tokens
1120	            // 0)                          as $ti
1121	      | num($result.output_tokens
1122	            // $result.total_completion_tokens
1123	            // $result.n_output_tokens
1124	            // 0)                          as $to
1125	      | num($result.cached_input_tokens
1126	            // $result.total_cached_input_tokens
1127	            // $result.n_cached_input_tokens
1128	            // 0)                          as $tc
1129	      | num($result.cost_usd // $result.total_cost_usd // 0) as $reported
1130	      | (($ti * $pi) + ($to * $po) + ($tc * $pc)) / 1000000  as $priced
1131	      | (if $priced > 0 then $priced
1132	         elif ($pi + $po + $pc) == 0 then $reported
1133	         else 0
1134	         end)
1135	      | tostring
1136	    '
1137	}

1475	# run_cell_with_per_cell_retry invokes run_one_cell with per-cell retry logic
1476	# for transient errors. Each retry attempt gets a fresh cell_id and cell_dir,
1477	# linked via attempt_of/superseded_by. Returns the final cell_dir.
1478	# initial_attempt_of="" disables initial attempt_of tracking.
1479	run_cell_with_per_cell_retry() {
1480	  local out="$1" profile_id="$2" profile_file="$3"
1481	  local framework="$4" dataset="$5" dataset_dir="$6" task="$7"
1482	  local rep_idx="$8" total_reps="$9" adapter="${10}"
1483	  local te_ver="${11}" hd="${12}" interrupted_flag="${13:-}" initial_attempt_of="${14:-}"
1484	
1485	  local max_attempts="${BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS}"
1486	  local backoff="${BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE}"
1487	  local attempt=1
1488	  local prior_cell_dir="${initial_attempt_of}"
1489	
1490	  while :; do
1491	    local cell_dir
1492	    cell_dir="$(run_one_cell "${out}" "${profile_id}" "${profile_file}" \
1493	                  "${framework}" "${dataset}" "${dataset_dir}" "${task}" \
1494	                  "${rep_idx}" "${total_reps}" "${adapter}" "${prior_cell_dir}" \
1495	                  "${te_ver}" "${hd}" "${interrupted_flag}")"
1496	
1497	    if [[ ! -f "${cell_dir}/report.json" ]]; then
1498	      # No result to check, just return the cell
1499	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1500	      return 0
1501	    fi
1502	
1503	    local error_class final_status
1504	    error_class="$(jq -r '.error_class // ""' "${cell_dir}/report.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '')"
1505	    final_status="$(jq -r '.final_status // ""' "${cell_dir}/report.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '')"
1506	
1507	    # If non-transient error or success, stop retrying
1508	    if [[ -z "${error_class}" ]] || ! is_transient_error_class "${error_class}"; then
1509	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1510	      return 0
1511	    fi
1512	
1513	    # If max attempts reached, mark final cell with transient_exhausted and stop
1514	    if (( attempt >= max_attempts )); then
1515	      local tmp
1516	      tmp="$(mktemp)"
1517	      jq '. + {final_status:"transient_exhausted"}' "${cell_dir}/report.json" >"${tmp}"
1518	      mv "${tmp}" "${cell_dir}/report.json"
1519	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1520	      return 0
1521	    fi
1522	
1523	    # Transient error and more attempts available: sleep and retry
1524	    warn "cell $(basename "${cell_dir}"): transient error (attempt ${attempt}/${max_attempts}); sleeping ${backoff}s before retry"
1525	    sleep "${backoff}"
1526	    backoff=$((backoff * 2))
1527	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
1528	    prior_cell_dir="${cell_dir}"
1529	  done

1570	run_sweep() {

1588	  if [[ -n "${max_cost_usd}" ]]; then
1589	    init_budget "${out}" "${max_cost_usd}"
1590	  fi

1593	  local interrupted_flag
1594	  interrupted_flag="${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}/.benchmark-interrupt-$$"
1595	
1596	  # Trap handler for SIGINT/SIGTERM: interrupt running cells, wait for cleanup
1597	  handle_interrupt() {
1598	    local grace_seconds="${BENCH_TERM_GRACE_SECONDS}"
1599	    [[ -f "${interrupted_flag}" ]] && return 0
1600	    warn "Received signal, stopping cell submission and interrupting running cells..."
1601	    touch "${interrupted_flag}"
1602	
1603	    # Terminate in-flight cells
1604	    interrupt_inflight_cells
1605	
1606	    # Send SIGTERM to all child processes (the background job pool)
1607	    local pids
1608	    pids="$(jobs -p)"
1609	    if [[ -n "${pids}" ]]; then
1610	      kill -TERM ${pids} 2>/dev/null || true
1611	
1612	      # Wait up to grace_seconds for them to exit
1613	      local elapsed=0
1614	      while (( elapsed < grace_seconds )); do
1615	        pids="$(jobs -p)"
1616	        if [[ -z "${pids}" ]]; then
1617	          break
1618	        fi
1619	        sleep 1
1620	        elapsed=$((elapsed + 1))
1621	      done
1622	
1623	      # Force kill any stragglers
1624	      pids="$(jobs -p)"
1625	      if [[ -n "${pids}" ]]; then
1626	        kill -KILL ${pids} 2>/dev/null || true
1627	      fi
1628	    fi
1629	  }
1630	
1631	  trap 'handle_interrupt' SIGINT SIGTERM
1632	
1633	  local active_jobs=0
1634	
1635	  IFS=',' read -r -a profile_ids <<<"${profiles_csv}"
1636	  IFS=',' read -r -a bench_set_ids <<<"${bench_sets_csv}"
1637	
1638	  local profile_id bs_id bs_file profile_file
1639	  local framework dataset dataset_dir reps tasks harness adapter
1640	  local terminal_file invalid_file orphan_file
1641	  local concurrency_group

1643	  for profile_id in "${profile_ids[@]}"; do
1644	    [[ -n "${profile_id}" ]] || continue
1645	    profile_file="$(resolve_profile_file "${profile_id}")"

1653	      [[ -n "${bs_id}" ]] || continue

1655	      framework="$(bench_set_framework "${bs_file}")"
1656	      dataset="$(bench_set_dataset "${bs_file}")"
1657	      dataset_dir="${dataset}"

1690	          done <"${invalid_file}"
1691	          while IFS= read -r prior; do
1692	            [[ -n "${prior}" ]] || continue
1693	            cells_to_run+=("${profile_id}|${profile_file}|${framework}|${dataset}|${dataset_dir}|${task}|1|${reps}|${adapter}|${te_ver}|${hd}|${max_cost_usd}|${concurrency_group}|${prior}")

1740	            "${fw}" "${ds}" "${ds_dir}" "${tsk}" \
1741	            "${rep_idx}" "${t_reps}" "${adp}" \
1742	            "${te_v}" "${hd_v}" "${cap}" "${interrupted_flag}" "${prior_cell}"
1743	
1744	          active_jobs=$((active_jobs + 1))
1745	        done
1746	
1747	        rm -f "${terminal_file}" "${invalid_file}" "${orphan_file}"
1748	      done <<<"${tasks}"
1749	    done
1750	  done
1751	
1752	  # Wait for all background jobs to complete
1753	  wait
1754	  local exit_code=0

1756	  rm -f "${interrupted_flag}"
1757	  trap - SIGINT SIGTERM
